svg.title: Artificial Intelligence Tasks: source-backed reference mind map
svg.desc: A top-down mind map. The grouping is an editorial synthesis, not an official or exhaustive standard. Concepts overlap. Each source marker opens a primary publication, author textbook or official documentation.

text.tspan: A I / R E F E R E N C E M A P
Defined inputs and outputs across eight task families
Technical task names are source-linked; the family layout is an editorial navigation aid.

g.title: Text Classification: Text → category labels. Source: GLUE
Natural Language Inference: Premise + hypothesis → relation. Source: GLUE
Named Entity Recognition: Text → named spans and types. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Relation Extraction: Text + entities → relations. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Coreference Resolution: Text → linked mentions. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Part-of-Speech Tagging: Tokens → grammatical tags. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Syntactic Parsing: Sentence → grammatical structure. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Text Generation: Context → generated text. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Machine Translation: Source-language text → target text. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Text Summarization: Document → condensed account. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Multi-document Summarization: Documents → combined summary. Source: MS2: Multi-Document Summarization
Grammatical Error Correction: Erroneous text → corrected text. Source: CoNLL-2014 Grammatical Error Correction
Question Answering: Question (+ context) → answer. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Dialogue Response Generation: Dialogue context → next response. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Semantic Textual Similarity: Text pair → similarity score. Source: GLUE
Document Retrieval: Query + corpus → relevant documents. Source: Introduction to Information Retrieval
Passage Retrieval: Query + passages → relevant passages. Source: BEIR
Re-ranking: Query + candidates → revised ranking. Source: BEIR
Query Expansion: Query + evidence → expanded query. Source: Introduction to Information Retrieval
Top-k Recommendation: User context + items → ranked items. Source: RecBole Evaluation Support
Rating Prediction: User–item pair → predicted rating. Source: RecBole Evaluation Support
Image Classification: Image → class labels. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Object Detection: Image → object boxes and classes. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Semantic Segmentation: Image → per-pixel class labels. Source: Image Segmentation
Instance Segmentation: Image → individual object masks. Source: Image Segmentation
Depth Estimation: Image → depth map. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Keypoint Detection: Image → landmark coordinates. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Video Classification: Video → class or action labels. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Optical Character Recognition: Text image → recognized text. Source: Image-to-Text
Image Captioning: Image → textual description. Source: Image-to-Text
Visual Question Answering: Image + question → answer. Source: Visual Question Answering
Document Question Answering: Document image + question → answer. Source: Document Question Answering
Text-to-Image Generation: Text prompt → image. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Image-to-Image Generation: Image + conditioning → new image. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Image Inpainting: Image + mask → completed image. Source: Image Inpainting
Text-to-Video Generation: Text prompt → video. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Image-to-Video Generation: Image + conditioning → video. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Text-to-3D Generation: Text description → 3D representation. Source: Shap-E
Automatic Speech Recognition: Speech → transcript. Source: SUPERB
Speech Translation: Speech → text in another language. Source: SUPERB-SG
Keyword Spotting: Speech → target-word detection. Source: SUPERB
Speech Emotion Recognition: Speech → emotion label. Source: SUPERB
Audio Classification: Sound clip → class labels. Source: Hugging Face Tasks
Speaker Identification: Speech → enrolled speaker identity. Source: SUPERB
Speaker Verification: Speech pair → same-speaker decision. Source: SUPERB
Speaker Diarization: Audio → who spoke when. Source: SUPERB
Text-to-Speech: Text → spoken waveform. Source: Speech and Language Processing
Speech Enhancement: Noisy speech → cleaner speech. Source: SUPERB-SG
Speech Separation: Mixed speech → speaker signals. Source: SUPERB-SG
Voice Conversion: Speech + target voice → converted speech. Source: SUPERB-SG
Text-to-Audio Generation: Sound description → audio. Source: AudioGen
Conditional Music Generation: Text or melody → music. Source: MusicGen
Text-to-Code Generation: Natural-language specification → code. Source: CodeXGLUE
Code Completion: Code context → continuation. Source: CodeXGLUE
Code Repair: Faulty code → corrected code. Source: CodeXGLUE
Code Translation: Code → equivalent code in another language. Source: CodeXGLUE

text.tspan: Code → equivalent code in another language

g.title: Text-to-SQL: Question + database schema → SQL. Source: Spider
Code Summarization: Code → natural-language description. Source: CodeXGLUE
Code Search: Natural-language query → relevant code. Source: CodeXGLUE
Code Clone Detection: Code pair → clone / similarity label. Source: CodeXGLUE
Defect Detection: Code → defect or vulnerability label. Source: CodeXGLUE
Classification: Feature vector → category. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Regression: Feature vector → numerical target. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Time-Series Forecasting: Past observations → future values. Source: sktime API Reference
Clustering: Observations → groups. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Dimensionality Reduction: Features → lower-dimensional representation. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Density Estimation: Observations → probability density. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Anomaly Detection: Observations → anomaly scores or flags. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Missing-Value Imputation: Incomplete data → estimated missing values. Source: scikit-learn User Guide
Change-Point Detection: Time series → regime-change locations. Source: sktime API Reference

text.tspan: Graph tasks and selected scientific tasks

g.title: Node Classification: Graph + nodes → node labels. Source: Open Graph Benchmark
Link Prediction: Graph + node pairs → link scores. Source: Open Graph Benchmark
Graph Classification: Graph → graph-level labels. Source: Open Graph Benchmark
Graph Regression: Graph → graph-level numerical targets. Source: Open Graph Benchmark
Molecular Property Prediction: Molecule representation → properties. Source: MoleculeNet
Protein Structure Prediction: Sequence + context → 3D protein structure. Source: AlphaFold
Math Word-Problem Solving: Mathematical word problem → solution. Source: GSM8K: Training Verifiers
Formal Theorem Proving: Formal statement → verifiable proof. Source: miniF2F
Constraint Satisfaction: Variables + constraints → valid assignment. Source: AI: A Modern Approach, 4th ed.
Classical Planning: Initial state + actions + goal → plan. Source: AI: A Modern Approach, 4th ed.
Robot Localization: Sensor observations + map → robot pose. Source: AI: A Modern Approach, 4th ed.
Robot Motion Planning: Start + goal + obstacles → feasible path. Source: AI: A Modern Approach, 4th ed.
Function Calling: Request + tool schemas → function arguments. Source: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
Web Task Execution: Goal + website state → completed task. Source: WebArena
Desktop Task Execution: Goal + desktop state → completed task. Source: OSWorld

text.tspan: SCOPE • Selected established task formulations; no single benchmark or institution defines this complete hierarchy.
Families overlap: captioning is both visual and linguistic; graph regression is also regression. Amber cards evaluate complete systems.
8 navigation families / 85 task entries / 2 explicitly marked system-level tasks
S01–S48 are clickable source references. Sources: author textbooks, original papers and official documentation. Curated 21 October 2026.
